akkugrg2012: Isidor Akkugrg arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
cosmicloopy: In Brennmoor, Silas Cosmicloopy was a lamplighter. In R-R13, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.
janzhhhhhhhhhh: Marek Janzhhhhhhhh left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Greyhallow and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he keeps feeding the rats.
Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall held the mirror while Marek Janzhhhhhhhh shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
joseph.olivas.3762: Pavel Olivas left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
linningorchid980: On the way to R-F6, Dietrich Linningorchi tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Dietrich Linningorchi checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
A bullet went through Dietrich Linningorchi's sleeve at R-F6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Gustav "Mud" Raptor of the Concord (@raptor2561).

Dietrich Linningorchi wore a fresh bandage at R-F6 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Dietrich Linningorchi helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dietrich Linningorchi sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.
The medics cleaned Dietrich Linningorchi's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F6.
Dietrich Linningorchi was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
Dietrich Linningorchi remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
shpkunky: Dorian Shpkunky came up the line with a rosary of rough beads and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
weirddough___: Isidor Weirddough left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Wyvern Cross and came up the line with a tin of tobacco. The men noticed at once that he shares cigarettes but never smokes.
